head_commit.message:
wp1361: ghim lai dau van + guong cong Windows sau #1343 (chia manh packet-loop)

Nen a0702d0. #1343 (26090fd) tach gate-packet-loop thanh 16 job manh
gate-packet-loop-manh + job gom gate-packet-loop; bang ghim $DauVanCi cua
chay-cong-windows_test.ps1 con o nen 9aa40ac nen t32 DO, va bon khoa env moi
(PACKET_LOOP_MANH, PACKET_LOOP_RA, PACKET_LOOP, KQ_MANH) lam t30 DO.

- test: ghim 'gate-packet-loop' = 67a508fb841f, them 'gate-packet-loop-manh'
  = c386d4cf83f3; chu thich ghim liet ke doi NGOAI lenh va doi LENH (M1, M3);
  ghi chu t9: bieu thuc 240/150 nay o job manh, job gom 10 phut (M4).
- script: giu packet_loop_test.py TRON, them mot dong THAY BANG neu ten hai
  buoc manh + gom (M2); xoa bon khoa env moi o ranh gioi nhu moi khoa CI khai
  ma script khong dat; cap nhat .DESCRIPTION/.PARAMETER.

Khong doi logic chot cua Tim-ThieuGuong/Doc-DauVanCi.
Do pwsh 7.4.6 tren Linux: base 34/36 (t30, t32 DO) -> head 36/36.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015GtxrZW6pNVo2pzPjPP93h
